知识对齐监督微调研究A Study of Knowledge-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning

Arthur Becker Affiliation: AppTek GmbH, Aachen, Germany & F-Bureaucracy UG, Aachen, Germany Affiliation: Equal contribution.    Jakob Kemmler Affiliation: AppTek GmbH, Aachen, Germany Affiliation: Equal contribution.    David Thulke Affiliation: AppTek GmbH, Aachen, Germany & RWTH Aachen University, Germany Affiliation: Corresponding author: dthulke@apptek.com    Christine Schäfer Affiliation: AppTek GmbH, Aachen, Germany    Christian Dugast Affiliation: AppTek GmbH, Aachen, Germany    Hermann Ney Affiliation: AppTek GmbH, Aachen, Germany & RWTH Aachen University, Germany
摘要Abstract

监督微调（SFT）训练基础语言模型来模仿目标响应，而这些目标可能需要基础模型尚未稳健内化的知识。 我们将其作为幻觉的来源进行研究，并制定了一组缓解方法：Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trains a base language model to imitate target responses, and these targets may require knowledge the base model has not robustly internalized. We study this as a source of hallucinations and frame a group of mitigation methods as知识一致的SFTknowledge-aligned SFT：将 SFT 训练目标限制为基础模型的参数知识。 在统一的设置下，我们比较了现有的基于生成和基于估计的知识对齐方法，并引入了两种新的变体：: constraining SFT training targets to the base model’s parametric knowledge. Under a unified setup, we compare existing generation-based and estimation-based knowledge-alignment methods and introduce two new variants:证据重写Evidence Rewrite，它使用外部证据验证基础模型的生成，以及, which verifies base-model generations using external evidence, and回忆重写Recall Rewrite，只有当基本模型能够一致地调用它们时，它才会保留声明。 Qwen 3 4B 和 OLMo 3 7B 的实验表明，知识一致的 SFT 可以减少 WildHalu 和 Biography 上的事实幻觉，同时在很大程度上保留一般能力。, which retains claims only when they can be consistently recalled by the base model. Experiments with Qwen 3 4B and OLMo 3 7B show that knowledge-aligned SFT can reduce factual hallucinations on WildHalu and Biography while largely preserving general capabilities.回忆重写Recall Rewrite产生最强的事实性增益并改善 UnknownBench 上的拒绝行为。 因此，它证实了 SFT 的目标超出了基础模型的知识驱动幻觉行为。yields the strongest factuality gains and improves refusal behavior on UnknownBench. It thereby confirms that SFT targets beyond the base model’s knowledge drive hallucination behavior.

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型 (LLM) 通常会生成流畅的答案，其中包含不受支持或错误的主张，这种失败模式通常称为幻觉。 我们专注于Large language models (LLMs) often generate fluent answers that contain unsupported or false claims, a failure mode commonly referred to as hallucination. We focus on事实幻觉factuality hallucinations：生成与现实世界事实相矛盾的主张: generated claims that contradict real-world factsHuang et al. (2025b)。 对于指令跟踪模型来说，这尤其成问题，因为用户经常依赖于难以检测错误的领域中的详细答案。. This is especially problematic for instruction-following models, where users frequently rely on detailed answers in domains where errors are difficult to detect.

有监督微调 (SFT) 是将预训练基础模型转变为指令跟踪模型的核心步骤Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a central step for turning a pre-trained base model into an instruction-following modelOuyang et al. (2022)。 指令调优将模型暴露于广泛的任务混合中，以改进指令跟踪以及对新任务和领域的泛化. Instruction tuning exposes models to broad task mixtures to improve instruction following and generalization to new tasks and domainsWei et al. (2022); Longpre et al. (2023)。 然而，实际的 SFT 示例提供了两个相互交织的信号：它们教导模型. However, factual SFT examples provide two intertwined signals: they teach the model如何how回答，同时还要求其提出事实主张。如果这些主张在预训练期间没有被牢固地内化，模型就会被迫产生超出其参数知识的合理主张。 先前的研究表明这是 SFT 中幻觉的驱动因素to answer, while also requiring it to produce factual claims. If these claims are not robustly internalized during pre-training, models are pushed to produce plausible claims beyond their parametric knowledge. Prior work established that this is a driver of hallucinations in SFTGekhman et al. (2024); Lin et al. (2024); Wu et al. (2025); Kaplan et al. (2026)。 更广泛地说，SFT 并不是一种注入新知识的糟糕工具，因为可靠地学习新的事实关联需要大量证据. More broadly, SFT is a poor vehicle for injecting new knowledge, because learning new factual associations reliably requires extensive evidenceKandpal et al. (2023)并且SFT阶段相对较小（and the SFT stage is comparatively small (Guo et al., 2025; 34）。 检索增强或持续预训练更适合此目的). Retrieval augmentation or continued pre-training are better suited for this purposeOvadia et al. (2024); Xu et al. (2023).

此外，SFT 强烈影响模型的响应行为： 它教导何时回答、提供多少细节以及如何自信地提出主张。 如果监督目标需要基础模型参数之外的知识，SFT 会奖励不确定性下看起来有效的答案，而不是尊重模型的知识边界。 这鼓励猜测而不是拒绝，呼应了这样的论点：常见的训练和评估设置会奖励不确定性下的答案，同时惩罚不确定性的表达Additionally, SFT strongly shapes the model’s response behavior: it teaches when to answer, how much detail to provide, and how confidently to present claims. If supervision targets require knowledge outside the base model’s parameters, SFT rewards valid-looking answers under uncertainty rather than respect for the model’s knowledge boundary. This encourages guessing rather than refusing, echoing the argument that common training and evaluation setups reward answers under uncertainty while penalizing expressions of uncertaintyKalai et al. (2025).

我们通过以下视角来研究这个问题We study this problem through the lens of知识对齐knowledge alignment：将 SFT 目标与基础模型中已有的事实知识相匹配。 因此，知识一致的 SFT 旨在保留 SFT 的行为效益，同时减少猜测超出基本模型知识的动机。: matching SFT targets to the factual knowledge already available in the base model. Knowledge-aligned SFT therefore aims to preserve SFT’s behavioral benefits while reducing the incentive to guess beyond the base model’s knowledge.Figure 1总结了我们的框架。 标准 SFT 可能要求模型模仿包含它不知道的事实的响应，这扩大了看似合理但不受支持的世代的空间。 相反，知识对齐的 SFT 将事实监督限制在基础模型可以支持的范围内。summarizes our framing. Standard SFT may require the model to imitate responses containing facts it does not know, which expands the space of plausible-looking but unsupported generations. Knowledge-aligned SFT instead constrains factual supervision to what the base model can support.

在这项工作中，我们在统一框架下提供了知识对齐 SFT 方法的受控比较。 我们比较基于世代的对齐方式，以 FLAME 为代表In this work, we provide a controlled comparison of knowledge-aligned SFT methods under a unified framework. We compare generation-based alignment, represented by FLAMELin et al. (2024)，基于估计的对齐，由不确定性感知过滤 UNIT 表示, with estimation-based alignment, represented by uncertainty-aware filtering UNIT切cut Wu et al. (2025)，并引入两个变体：, and introduce two variants:证据重写Evidence Rewrite，它通过外部声明验证过滤基本模型生成，以及, which filters base-model generations through external claim verification, and回忆重写Recall Rewrite，它探究基本模型是否可以一致地调用声明。 在事实性、拒绝性和一般能力评估方面，知识一致的监督减少了可测量的幻觉，同时保留了广泛的模型能力。 我们的贡献是在真实的指令调优数据上实现这一前提。 我们将训练响应的每个单独声明分类为基本模型已知或未知，并相应地对 SFT 目标进行干预。 在, which probes whether claims can be consistently recalled by the base model. Across factuality, refusal, and general capability evaluations, knowledge-aligned supervision reduces measured hallucinations while preserving broad model capabilities. Our contribution is to operationalize this premise on real instruction-tuning data. We classify each individual claim of a training response as known or unknown to the base model and intervene on the SFT targets accordingly. InSection 4.4我们还通过仅改变其他相同的训练数据中已知声明的份额来重现我们的管道中的因果效应。 我们发布了两个基本模型的 Recall Rewrite 训练数据以及所有中间管道输出（we additionally reproduce the causal effect within our pipeline by varying only the share of known claims in otherwise identical training data. We release the Recall Rewrite training data for both base models together with all intermediate pipeline outputs (Section 4.1, Footnote 3).

3.2 提议的方法Proposed Methods

两种提出的方法以及上面的两个基线都是单个数据构建过程的实例，其区别仅在于源响应以及如何将声明分类为已知。 我们将这个通用结构明确地写在Both proposed methods, as well as the two baselines above, are instances of a single data-construction procedure that differs only in the source response and in how claims are classified as known. We make this common structure explicit inAppendix B.

3.2.1 证据重写Evidence Rewrite

证据重写Evidence Rewrite (Figure 2）通过添加外部验证步骤来完善 FLAME 的基于生成的对齐策略。 FLAME 将每一个自我生成的主张视为已知，即使它可能实际上不正确，因此我们过滤掉没有外部证据支持的主张。) refines the generation-based alignment strategy of FLAME by adding an external verification step. FLAME treats every self-generated claim as known even though it may be factually incorrect, so we filter out claims that are not supported by external evidence.

与 FLAME 一样，非知识寻求的提示将保留其黄金响应。 对于每个知识寻求提示As in FLAME, prompts that are not knowledge-seeking keep their gold response. For each knowledge-seeking promptPP，我们对长格式响应进行采样, we sample a long-form responseR^∼Mbase\hat{R}\sim M_{\text{base}}。 我们应用标准的事实检查流程（主张分解、证据检索和验证；. We apply a standard fact-checking pipeline (claim decomposition, evidence retrieval, and verification;Appendix D）对每个权利要求进行分类) to classify each claim inR^\hat{R}支持或不支持。 然后我们使用重写器模型as supported or unsupported. We then use a rewriter modelMrewriterM_{\text{rewriter}}，以提示和支持的主张为条件，撰写流畅一致的回应, conditioned on the prompt and the supported claims, to compose a fluent aligned responseR∗R^{*}。 在我们的框架下，证据重写将一项声明分类为已知，前提是它是自行生成的并经过验证为支持的。 如果支持的声明提供的信息不足以解决. Under our framework, Evidence Rewrite thus classifies a claim as known iff it is self-generated and verified as supported. If the supported claims provide insufficient information to addressPP，提示符指示, the prompt instructsMrewriterM_{\text{rewriter}}而是拒绝回应。 为了减轻由声明过滤引起的响应缩短，我们在事实检查之前引入了一个额外的头脑风暴步骤，指示基础模型在给定初始短生成的情况下生成更长、更详细的响应（请参阅to refuse to respond instead. To mitigate response shortening caused by claim filtering, we introduce an additional brainstorming step before fact-checking that instructs the base model to generate a longer, more detailed response given an initial short generation (seeAppendix J).

4.2 主要结果Main Results

Table 1总结了所有方法在 WildHalu 和 Biography 任务上的表现。在这两个数据集中，所有知识一致的变体（FLAME 除外）在 %Supp 方面始终优于标准 SFT。和 FActScore，表明幻觉减少。这与将监督与模型参数知识相结合可以减少幻觉的前提是一致的，并且summarizes the performance of all methods on the WildHalu and Biography tasks. Across both datasets, all knowledge-aligned variants (except FLAME) consistently outperform standard SFT in terms of %Supp. and FActScore, indicating reduced hallucinations. This is consistent with the premise that aligning supervision with the model’s parametric knowledge reduces hallucinations, andSection 4.4直接测试一下。tests it directly.

Recall Rewrite 实现了最高的 %Supp。和 FActScore 在两个数据集上，但代价是支持的索赔减少 (#Supp.) 和拒绝率大幅增加。 相比之下，单位Recall Rewrite achieves the highest %Supp. and FActScore on both datasets, but at the cost of fewer supported claims (#Supp.) and substantially increased refusal rates. In contrast, UNIT切cut和证据重写保留了更多支持的主张，但实现了较低的％Supp.，反映了幻觉减少和覆盖范围之间的一致权衡：更严格的过滤产生更可靠但信息量更少的输出。 拒绝行为是这种权衡的核心，因为 FActScore 将拒绝视为完全支持。 FActScore 较高的方法，尤其是 Recall Rewrite 和 Qwen 3 Instruct，表现出较高的拒绝率，尤其是在包含许多长尾事实的 Biography 任务上。 每个实体的比较（and Evidence Rewrite retain more supported claims but achieve lower %Supp., reflecting a consistent trade-off between hallucination reduction and coverage: stricter filtering yields more reliable but less informative outputs. Refusal behavior is central to this trade-off because FActScore treats refusals as fully supported. Methods with higher FActScore, particularly Recall Rewrite and Qwen 3 Instruct, exhibit higher refusal rates, especially on the Biography task, which contains many long-tail facts. A per-entity comparison (Section I.2）表明这些拒绝几乎完全涉及标准 SFT 幻觉的实体，而对知名实体的过度拒绝确实发生在 WildHalu 上。 因此，Recall Rewrite 较高的 FActScore 不应被解释为同等覆盖率下事实生成的改进。 相反，它反映了更为保守的应对政策：非拒绝响应中支持的索赔比例上升，而支持的索赔总数下降。) shows that these refusals almost exclusively concern entities on which standard SFT hallucinates, while over-refusals on well-known entities do occur on WildHalu. Recall Rewrite’s higher FActScore should therefore not be interpreted as improved factual generation at equal coverage. It instead reflects a more conservative response policy: the fraction of supported claims among non-refusal responses rises, while the total number of supported claims falls.

比较基于生成和估计的方法，FLAME 并没有比标准 SFT 有所改进，这表明朴素生成是参数知识的不可靠代理。添加过滤或验证（证据重写）始终优于 FLAME。同样，虽然 UNITComparing generation- and estimation-based approaches, FLAME does not improve over standard SFT, suggesting that naive generation is an unreliable proxy for parametric knowledge. Adding filtering or verification (Evidence Rewrite) consistently improves over FLAME. Similarly, while UNIT切cut与基于生成的方法相比，Recall Rewrite 实现了更高的测量事实性，这表明了一种更可靠但更保守的知识对齐策略。outperforms generation-based methods, Recall Rewrite achieves higher measured factuality, suggesting a more reliable but more conservative knowledge-alignment strategy.

官方 Qwen 3 Instruct 模型仍然比所有 OASST1 训练的变体更强。 这种比较不受控制：官方模型在指令数据规模和构成、训练后阶段以及可能的基准污染方面有所不同。 因此，我们的目标不是超越 Qwen 3 Instruct 的完整训练后配方，而是隔离知识一致的 SFT 数据是否可以在共享训练设置下提高事实性。 Tülu 3 SFTThe official Qwen 3 Instruct model remains stronger than all OASST1-trained variants. This comparison is not controlled: the official model differs in instruction data scale and composition, post-training stages, and possible benchmark contamination. Our goal is therefore not to outperform the complete post-training recipe of Qwen 3 Instruct, but to isolate whether knowledge-aligned SFT data improves factuality under a shared training setup. The Tülu 3 SFTLambert et al. (2025)基线表明，仅仅增加 SFT 数据规模并不能解决问题。baseline suggests that simply increasing SFT data scale does not remove the problem.

4.3 多阶段后期培训Multi-Stage Post-Training

对于 Qwen 3 指示 SFT 后的数据混合和中间检查点不可用。 为了更好地了解不同训练阶段的潜在影响，我们求助于 OLMo 3 InstructFor Qwen 3 Instruct the data mixture and intermediate checkpoints after SFT are not available. To better understand the potential impact of different training stages, we turn to OLMo 3 Instruct(34)，SFT、偏好优化（DPO）和具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）之后的公共检查点可用。, for which public checkpoints after SFT, preference optimization (DPO) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) are available.Table 2显示 7B 参数模型的不同训练后检查点的结果。 与 SFT 相比，DPO 检查点增加了支持的索赔数量 (#Supp.)，同时也增加了拒绝的数量。 RLVR 检查点进一步改进了%Supp。和事实分数。 这些趋势表明，额外的培训阶段可以提高事实可靠性。shows the results for different post-training checkpoints of the 7B parameter model. Compared to SFT, the DPO checkpoint increases the number of supported claims (#Supp.) while also increasing refusals. The RLVR checkpoint further improves %Supp. and FActScore. These trends suggest that additional training stages can improve factual reliability.

为了进行比较，我们从 OLMo 3 7B 基本模型开始在 OASST1 上训练标准 SFT 和召回重写模型。 尽管 Recall Rewrite 仅依赖于具有知识对齐数据的 SFT，但它始终能够实现更高的 %Supp。 WildHalu 上的 FActScore 优于所有 OLMo 检查点，同时保持支持的索赔数量相当。 总而言之，这些结果表明，在我们的设置中，知识一致的数据构建可以实现与额外的训练后阶段相当的收益；这些收益是否与面向事实的强化学习相结合仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。For comparison, we train a standard SFT and Recall Rewrite model on OASST1 starting from the OLMo 3 7B base model. Although Recall Rewrite relies solely on SFT with knowledge-aligned data, it consistently achieves higher %Supp. and FActScore on WildHalu than all OLMo checkpoints, while maintaining a comparable number of supported claims. Taken together, these results suggest that, in our setup, knowledge-aligned data construction can achieve gains comparable to additional post-training stages; whether these gains stack with factuality-oriented RL remains open.

4.5 拒绝行为Refusal Behavior

评估拒绝行为提供了对幻觉的补充视角：理想情况下，模型应该拒绝无法回答的问题，同时响应其知识范围内的问题。 为了评估这个维度，我们使用Evaluating refusal behavior provides a complementary perspective on hallucinations: a model should ideally refuse unanswerable questions while responding to those within its knowledge boundary. To evaluate this dimension, we use未知长凳UnknownBench Liu et al. (2024)，其中包含三个子任务。 每个子任务都将可回答的提示与不可回答的提示配对，并且子任务的不同之处在于如何构造不可回答的问题。, which comprises three subtasks. Each subtask pairs answerable with unanswerable prompts, and the subtasks differ in how the unanswerable questions are constructed.错误的质量保证FalseQA由 4,730 个问题组成，其中无法回答的实例假设实体之间不存在关系，即它们基于错误的前提。consists of 4,730 questions where the unanswerable instances assume non-existent relations between entities, i.e., they are based on false premises.日本电气公司NEC（不存在的概念）包含 4,144 个实例，并挑战模型根据发明的单词识别看似合理但捏造的概念。 无法回答的提示(Non-Existing Concepts) contains 4,144 instances and challenges the model to identify plausible but fabricated concepts based on invented words. The unanswerable prompts for拒绝QRefuNQ（总共 4,346 个实例）是通过用不存在的概念替换随机名词来创建的。 为了确保平衡的评估，我们对每个子任务中的实例进行随机下采样，以便可回答和不可回答问题的类别大小相等。(4,346 instances total) are created by replacing random nouns with non-existent concepts. 6 结论Conclusion

我们将 SFT 的幻觉归因于训练目标所需的事实主张与基础模型的参数知识之间不匹配的结果。 当目标需要不受支持的知识时，SFT 可以教会模型自信地回答超出其知识边界的问题。 知识对齐 SFT 通过将训练目标与模型的知识边界保持一致来解决这个问题。 我们的比较表明，如何近似这个边界很重要。 单纯的自我生成是不够的：在我们的环境中，FLAME 并没有比标准 SFT 提高事实性。 外部验证改进了基于生成的对齐，但我们实验中最大的度量增益来自召回重写，它直接探测基本模型是否能够一致地召回用于监督的声明。We framed hallucinations from SFT as a consequence of mismatch between the factual claims required by training targets and the parametric knowledge of the base model. When targets require unsupported knowledge, SFT may teach the model to answer confidently beyond its knowledge boundary. Knowledge-aligned SFT addresses this by aligning training targets with the model’s knowledge boundary. Our comparison shows that how this boundary is approximated matters. Naive self-generation is not sufficient: FLAME does not improve factuality over standard SFT in our setting. External verification improves generation-based alignment, but the largest metric gains in our experiments come from Recall Rewrite, which directly probes whether the base model can consistently recall the claims used for supervision.

在 Qwen 3 4B 和 OLMo 3 7B 中，以及更广泛的 WildHalu 设置和以维基百科为中心的传记评估中，知识一致的监督减少了可测量的幻觉，而不会明显损失此处考虑的一般能力基准。 UnknownBench 上的拒绝行为有所改善，但代价是事实覆盖率较低和错误拒绝增多。 额外的比较表明，这些收益不仅仅可以用 SFT 数据大小来解释，而且与更强大的训练后阶段相比，知识一致的数据构建仍然具有竞争力。 这些结果并不意味着知识一致的 SFT 取代了完整的指导模型训练后食谱，而是它可能针对的是此类食谱并不总是能解决的幻觉的独特来源。Across Qwen 3 4B and OLMo 3 7B, and both the broader WildHalu setting and the Wikipedia-centered Biography evaluation, knowledge-aligned supervision reduces measured hallucinations without clear losses on the general capability benchmarks considered here. Refusal behavior on UnknownBench improves at the cost of lower factual coverage and more false refusals. Additional comparisons suggest that the gains are not explained solely by SFT data size, and that knowledge-aligned data construction remains competitive with stronger post-training stages. These results do not imply that knowledge-aligned SFT replaces full instruct-model post-training recipes, but rather that it may target a distinct source of hallucinations that such recipes do not always address.

总体而言，知识对齐重写使SFT的事实内容成为可控变量，控制它可以减少幻觉行为。 将此控制应用于大型指令调整管道将需要比我们当前管道提供的更便宜的知识探测近似值。Overall, knowledge-aligned rewriting makes the factual content of SFT targets a controllable variable, and controlling it reduces hallucination behavior. Applying this control to large instruction-tuning pipelines will require cheaper approximations of the knowledge probing than our current pipeline provides.

局限性Limitations

我们的框架将模型的参数知识视为可以从模型行为近似的对象，但不能直接观察到。 因此，基于生成和基于召回的方法都提供了近似值Our framework treats a model’s parametric knowledge as an object that can be approximated from model behavior, but it cannot be observed directly. Both generation-based and recall-based methods therefore provide approximations of𝒦⁡(Mbase)\mathcal{K}(M_{\text{base}})。 此外，我们的表述很大程度上将事实知识视为二元属性：声明要么被分类为已知（并保留），要么被分类为未知（并被删除）。 相反，真实的模型可能会表现出分级的置信度、部分知识或对措辞的敏感性。 更明确地对这些区别进行建模可以进一步改进知识一致的数据构建。 相关地，我们的方法比较. In addition, our formulation largely treats factual knowledge as a binary property: a claim is either classified as known (and retained) or unknown (and removed). Real models may instead exhibit graded confidence, partial knowledge, or sensitivity to phrasing. Modeling these distinctions more explicitly could further improve knowledge-aligned data construction. Relatedly, our method comparisons inTable 1与训练目标的组成相关。 仅消融于are correlational with respect to the composition of the training targets. Only the ablation inSection 4.4操纵已知声明的份额，同时保持训练集大小和拒绝率固定，并且它针对单个基本模型和数据集这样做。manipulates the share of known claims while holding the training set size and refusal ratio fixed, and it does so for a single base model and dataset.

我们的评估还取决于自动事实性测量。 此外，它还以实体为中心：遵循长篇事实评估的标准实践，WildHalu 和 Biography 都引出对单个命名实体的描述。 WildHalu 超出了维基百科覆盖的实体（大约一半的实体缺乏维基百科页面Our evaluation also depends on automatic factuality measurement. It is furthermore entity-centric: following standard practice in long-form factuality evaluation, WildHalu and Biography both elicit descriptions of a single named entity. WildHalu extends beyond Wikipedia-covered entities (about half of its entities lack Wikipedia pagesZhao et al. (2024)），但是这两种基准测试都没有提示其事实内容不是围绕一个实体组织的。 声明分解、证据检索和验证阶段可能会引入错误，特别是对于未指定、难以检索或需要领域专业知识的声明。 最近许多有关长篇事实性评估的工作也存在这种局限性。 为了减少其影响，我们使用已建立的事实检查管道，并跨系统应用相同的评估程序，因此主要比较基于一致的测量协议。), but neither benchmark tests prompts whose factual content is not organized around one entity. The claim decomposition, evidence retrieval, and verification stages can introduce errors, especially for claims that are underspecified, difficult to retrieve, or require domain expertise. This limitation is shared with much recent work on long-form factuality evaluation. To reduce its impact, we use established fact-checking pipelines and apply the same evaluation procedure across systems, so the main comparisons are based on a consistent measurement protocol.

我们专注于监督微调，并没有完全描述知识对齐的 SFT 如何与后期训练后阶段相互作用。 OLMo 比较表明，面向事实的 DPO 或 RLVR 可以改善幻觉行为，但我们没有测试 Recall Rewrite 的收益是否与此类目标叠加。 研究这些组合是未来工作的一个重要方向，特别是对于已经包含强事实导向偏好或强化学习阶段的系统。We focus on supervised fine-tuning and do not fully characterize how knowledge-aligned SFT interacts with later post-training stages. The OLMo comparison suggests that factuality-oriented DPO or RLVR can improve hallucination behavior, but we do not test whether the gains from Recall Rewrite stack with such objectives. Studying these combinations is an important direction for future work, especially for systems that already include strong factuality-oriented preference or reinforcement learning stages.

可扩展性是另一个限制。 Recall Rewrite 需要声明分解、探测问题生成、重复的基本模型采样、蕴涵检查和响应重写，这使得它作为高精度诊断干预比作为所有 SFT 数据准备的完整可扩展配方更有用。 对于结合了许多事实、推理步骤或隐含背景假设的复杂回答，问题生成步骤也变得更加困难。 我们的实验使用 OASST1 的英语首轮子集，与当代指令调整混合物相比，该子集很小。 因此，我们的研究结果应该在更大的指令调整混合物和多语言或多轮对话、工具使用、编码、推理重提示和专业领域等环境中进行测试。Scalability is another limitation. Recall Rewrite requires claim decomposition, probing question generation, repeated base-model sampling, entailment checking, and response rewriting, making it more useful as a high-precision diagnostic intervention than as a complete scalable recipe for all SFT data preparation. The question-generation step also becomes more difficult for complex responses that combine many facts, reasoning steps, or implicit background assumptions. Our experiments use the English first-turn subset of OASST1, which is small compared to contemporary instruction-tuning mixtures. As a result, our findings should be tested on larger instruction-tuning mixtures and in settings such as multilingual or multi-turn dialogue, tool use, coding, reasoning-heavy prompts, and specialized domains.

最后，我们的重写流程依赖于强大的教师模型。 这些模型可以在主张选择、问题生成、验证、拒绝风格和重写答案的措辞方面引入自己的偏见。 使用多名教师、开放权重教师或人工审核可以帮助将教师特定的影响与将监督与基础模型的参数知识相结合的影响分开。Finally, our rewriting pipelines rely on strong teacher models. These models can introduce their own biases in claim selection, question generation, verification, refusal style, and the phrasing of rewritten answers. Using multiple teachers, open-weight teachers, or human audits could help separate teacher-specific effects from the effects of aligning supervision with the base model’s parametric knowledge.

单位UNIT切cut

Wu et al. (2025)研究教学微调中信息性和真实性之间的权衡，将幻觉归因于训练数据中包含不熟悉的长尾知识。为了解决这个问题，他们提出了不确定性感知指令微调，其中不确定性估计被用作模型是否知道给定信息的代理。在investigate the trade-off between informativeness and truthfulness in instruction fine-tuning, attributing hallucinations to the inclusion of unfamiliar, long-tail knowledge in training data. To address this, they propose uncertainty-aware instruction fine-tuning, where uncertainty estimates are used as a proxy for whether a model knows a given piece of information. In单位UNIT切cut, 每个黄金响应, each gold responseRR被分解为原子声明is decomposed into atomic claims𝒞⁡(R∣P)\mathcal{C}(R\mid P)，并且在训练之前删除具有高估计不确定性的声明以获得过滤响应, and claims with high estimated uncertainty are removed before training to obtain a filtered responseR∗R^{*}。这种过滤提高了真实性，但通常会因删除内容而降低信息量。. This filtering improves truthfulness but often reduces informativeness due to the removal of content.

然而，这种方法依赖于不确定性作为模型知识的不完美代理，模型知识可能会被错误校准或仅与参数知识相关性较弱。此外，单位However, this approach relies on uncertainty as an imperfect proxy for model knowledge, which may be miscalibrated or only weakly correlated with parametric knowledge. Furthermore, UNIT切cut仅针对明确陈述的主张进行操作，不考虑构建有效响应所需的隐含知识。特别是，响应通常取决于operates solely on explicitly stated claims and does not account for implicit knowledge required to construct a valid response. In particular, responses often depend on元知识meta-knowledge：未直接表达的事实、程序或结构信息: factual, procedural, or structural information that is not directly expressed inRR但仍然是生成所必需的。这些限制促使人们对模型知识进行更直接的估计，以捕获显性和隐性知识。but is nonetheless required for generation. These limitations motivate a more direct estimation of model knowledge that captures both explicit and implicit knowledge.

附录DAppendix D事实核查管道Fact-Checking Pipeline

本文在两个地方使用了事实检查管道：(i) 通过验证基础模型生成中的声明来构建 Evidence Rewrite 训练数据，以及 (ii) 在 WildHalu 和 Biography 基准上评估所有模型。在这两种情况下，管道都遵循以下三步方法：The fact-checking pipeline is used in two places in this paper: (i) to construct the Evidence Rewrite training data by verifying claims in base model generations, and (ii) to evaluate all models on the WildHalu and Biography benchmarks. In both cases, the pipeline follows the three-step approach ofMin et al. (2023).

权利要求分解。Claim Decomposition.

生成的文本首先使用以下方法分割成句子The generated text is first segmented into sentences using尼特克nltk Bird and Loper (2004)。然后应用滑动窗口通过 LLM 推理从每个句子中提取原子声明。主要目标是生成可验证原子声明的综合列表 - 可以根据外部源独立检查的单个声明。不同的实现在定义原子性方面有所不同，从而导致不同的提示模板. A sliding window is then applied to extract atomic claims from each sentence via LLM inference. The primary objective is to produce a comprehensive list of verifiable atomic claims — individual statements that can be independently checked against an external source. Different implementations vary in how they define atomicity, leading to different prompt templatesMin et al. (2023); Song et al. (2024)或额外的过滤步骤or additional filtering stepsWei et al. (2024).

我们使用VeriScore分解提示We use the VeriScore decomposition promptSong et al. (2024)而不是原来的 FActScore 提示rather than the original FActScore promptMin et al. (2023)。 FActScore 的分解是为传记生成而设计的，在 OASST1 等开放域指令跟踪数据上表现不佳：它经常提取无法针对任何外部来源进行验证的声明。常见的失败案例包括带有未解决的代词的主张（例如，. FActScore’s decomposition was designed for biography generation and performs poorly on open-domain instruction-following data such as OASST1: it frequently extracts claims that cannot be verified against any external source. Common failure cases include claims with unresolved pronouns (e.g.,“他出现在很多电影中。”"He has appeared in numerous films."）以及关于响应本身的元评论（例如，) and meta-commentary about the response itself (e.g.,“有提供的通道。”"There are provided passages."提取自extracted from“根据所提供的段落，以下是问题的答案：”"Based on the provided passages, here is the answer to the question:"）。 VeriScore 通过使用详细的说明和少量示例来解决这个问题，这些示例指导模型仅提取完全独立的并且可以根据外部源进行检查的声明，这与观察结果一致). VeriScore addresses this by using detailed instructions and few-shot examples that guide the model to only extract claims that are fully self-contained and can be checked against an external source, consistent with observations bySong et al. (2024).

证据检索。Evidence Retrieval.

对于证据重写训练数据构建和传记评估，使用两阶段分层方法从维基百科检索前五个支持证据。一、维基媒体APIFor Evidence Rewrite training data construction and Biography evaluation, the top five pieces of supporting evidence are retrieved from Wikipedia using a two-phase hierarchical approach. First, the Wikimedia API55 5 https://api.wikimedia.org/确定与该声明最相关的五个维基百科页面。其次，这些页面被分成块并使用重新排名identifies the five most relevant Wikipedia pages for the claim. Second, these pages are split into chunks and reranked usinggtr-t5-大号gtr-t5-large Ni et al. (2022)选择五个最相关的块作为证据。我们使用 2023 年 4 月 1 日提供的维基百科转储to select the five most pertinent chunks as evidence. We use the Wikipedia dump from 04/01/2023 provided byMin et al. (2023)，预处理成固定大小的块。对于 WildHalu 评估，我们改为遵循, preprocessed into fixed-size chunks. For WildHalu evaluation, we instead followWu et al. (2025)并使用其实现从 Google 搜索中检索证据and retrieve evidence from Google Search using their implementation66 6 https://github.com/AndrewWTY/UNIT.

索赔验证。Claim Verification.

附录HAppendix HUnknownBench 精度与召回率权衡UnknownBench Precision–Recall Trade-off

由于拒绝是一个离散的生成决策，因此我们的模型不会暴露推理时间置信阈值。 每个经过训练的模型对应于 UnknownBench 上的单个精确召回操作点，其保守性在训练时由知识对齐的强度决定。Since refusal is a discrete generation decision, our models do not expose an inference-time confidence threshold. Each trained model corresponds to a single precision–recall operating point on UnknownBench, and its conservativeness is instead determined at training time by the strength of knowledge alignment.Figure 7因此绘制结果therefore plots the results ofTable 4以及%已知的消融模型together with the %Known ablation models ofTable 3与 iso-F1 轮廓相对应。against iso-F1 contours.

在所有三个子任务中，Recall Rewrite 及其 100% 已知消融以精度换取了比基线高得多的召回率，并且 100% 已知模型在每个子任务上都获得了最高的 F1 (70.4 / 74.1 / 71.9)。 使用较大比例的未知声明（0% 和 50%）训练的消融模型以较低的精度回落至 NEC 和 RefuNQ 上的基线水平召回，即，它们拒绝的可靠性和选择性较低。On all three subtasks, Recall Rewrite and its 100%-known ablation trade precision for substantially higher recall than the baselines, and the 100%-known model attains the highest F1 on every subtask (70.4 / 74.1 / 71.9). The ablation models trained with a larger share of unknown claims (0% and 50%) fall back to baseline-level recall on NEC and RefuNQ at a lower precision, i.e., they refuse less reliably and less selectively.

召回重写拒绝 252 Bios 提示。 标准 SFT 回答了其中 248 个提示；对于 224 个 (90%) 来说，对同一实体的声明只有不到 40% 是真实的，并且只有一个实体（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva，39 个正确声明和 13 个错误声明）的标准 SFT 响应基本上是正确的。 因此，Bios 拒绝几乎完全涉及标准 SFT 幻觉的实体，例如 Maja JagerRecall Rewrite refuses on 252 Bios prompts. Standard SFT answers on 248 of these prompts; for 224 (90%), fewer than 40% of its claims for the same entity are true, and only for one entity (Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, 39 true and 13 false claims) is the standard SFT response predominantly correct. Bios refusals thus almost exclusively concern entities on which standard SFT hallucinates, such as Maja Jager inSection I.2，其中标准 SFT 发明了一位瑞典歌手，而实体是一位丹麦弓箭手。 40% 的阈值（如果有的话）夸大了标准 SFT 的质量，因为事实检查器标记了通用声明，例如, where standard SFT invents a Swedish singer while the entity is a Danish archer. The 40% threshold, if anything, overstates the quality of standard SFT, since the fact-checker marks generic claims such as“她已经发行了几张专辑”“she has released several albums”即使响应描述的是虚构的人，也是如此。 在 WildHalu 上，其实体的长尾较少（参见标准 SFT 的%Supp.）as true even when the response describes a fictitious person. Of the 55 refusals, 31 concern entities on which standard SFT is mostly wrong, but 8 concern entities on which it is mostly right. 标准SFTStandard SFT

It is commonly used to prevent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE) in patients who are at risk, such as those who have undergone surgery or have been bedridden for an extended period of time. It is also used to treat existing blood clots in the legs or lungs, and to prevent recurrent clots. Lovenox works by inhibiting the formation of blood clots, thereby reducing the risk of clot-related complications. It is administered via subcutaneous injection and is generally well-tolerated, although like all medications, it can cause side effects such as bleeding, bruising, and injection site reactions. As with any medication, Lovenox should only be used under the guidance of a healthcare provider.

提示：Prompt:Ashley 的披萨外卖费用为 15 美元。如果 Ashley 想给送货员相当于订单金额 1/5 的小费，那么她应该给送货员的总金额是多少？Ashley’s pizza delivery costs $15. What is the total amount that Ashley should give the delivery man if she wants to give a tip that is equal to 1/5 of the amount she ordered?

标准 SFT（正确）Standard SFT (correct)

小费应该是15 / 5 = 3美元。所以总金额应该是 15 + 3 = 18 美元。所以答案是18。The tip should be 15 / 5 = 3 dollars. So the total amount should be 15 + 3 = 18 dollars. So the answer is 18.

黄金答案：18（完全匹配）。只有标准 SFT 才能解决的 102 个 GSM8K 问题的典型问题：两个模型都会产生一系列算术步骤和一个数字答案。Gold answer: 18 (exact match). Typical of the 102 GSM8K problems that only standard SFT solves: both models produce a chain of arithmetic steps and a numeric answer.

 
IFEval。IFEval.

在 IFEval 上，情况有所不同。 Recall Rewrite 以 541 个提示中的 30 个提示的拒绝模板开始响应，并在 37 个响应中包含拒绝短语（标准 SFT：0 和 2）。 它在这 30 个提示上的准确率为 13.3%，而标准 SFT 的准确率为 66.7%，而在没有任何拒绝短语的 504 个提示上，两个模型的准确率相当（56.3% 对 56.5%）。 因此，拒绝解释了整个 IFEval 差异。 被拒绝的提示主要是创造性写作任务（笑话、诗歌、谜语、说唱）和意见问题，而不是寻求知识的问题（On IFEval, the picture is different. Recall Rewrite begins its response with the refusal template for 30 of the 541 prompts and contains a refusal phrase in 37 responses (standard SFT: 0 and 2). Its accuracy on these 30 prompts is 13.3% compared to 66.7% for standard SFT, whereas on the 504 prompts without any refusal phrase the two models are on par (56.3% vs. 56.5%). Refusals therefore account for the entire IFEval difference. The refused prompts are predominantly creative-writing tasks (jokes, poems, riddles, raps) and opinion questions rather than knowledge-seeking questions (Sections I.3和andI.3）。 训练数据中的 302 个拒绝包括拒绝此类提示（例如，). The 302 refusals in the training data include refusals to such prompts (e.g.,“给我讲个有趣的笑话吧！”“Tell me a funny joke!” or “请创建一张戴着帽子的猫的 ASCII 绘图。”“Please create an ASCII drawing of a cat wearing a hat.”，参见, cf.Section I.1），该模型似乎将其概括为拒绝创造性任务的倾向，即使它们不需要事实知识。 因此，减少训练数据中的此类过度拒绝是缩小 IFEval 差距的最直接手段。), which the model appears to generalize into a tendency to refuse creative tasks even though they require no factual knowledge. Reducing over-refusals of this kind in the training data is therefore the most direct lever for closing the IFEval gap.
